terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: if [ -d ../dealr-backend ]; then cd ../dealr-backend && export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON="$(cat serviceAccountKey.json)" && npm start; else echo 'dealr-backend repo not found next to dealr-web'; sleep infinity; fi
terminals.description: Dealr backend API (Express + Socket.IO) on http://localhost:3001, backed by local MongoDB.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Dealr React web app (CRA dev server) on http://localhost:3000, pointed at the local backend.

terminals.name: mobile-metro
terminals.command: if [ -d ../dealr-mobile ]; then cd ../dealr-mobile && npx expo start; else echo 'dealr-mobile repo not found next to dealr-web'; sleep infinity; fi
terminals.description: Expo Metro bundler for the Dealr mobile app (port 8081). Open in Expo Go / a dev build.
